title: Why Rust Helped Protect a 1,600-Year-Old Iron Pillar
description:
The iron pillar in Delhi has survived for roughly 1,600 years. Its secret is not that it never rusts: a dense corrosion layer helps slow further damage above ground, while the buried section has corroded more heavily.
